partner_result_applied.result: uniform quadratic negative-quarter moment from r15: sup_c E|Z^2-c|^(-1/4)<=4
partner_result_applied.direct_application: Combined with log_+ z <= (4/e) z^(1/4), the partner lemma turns the new small-shear product logarithm into a uniform density bound <29.076 on the normalized small-diagonal branch.

new_result.statement: For every invertible real symmetric 3x3 B, independent cap-one inputs, and arbitrary affine perturbation, the quadratic polynomial has essential density sup at most 216 |det B|^(-1/3). Conditioning gives the same certificate for any original-coordinate principal triple in a full ambient form.

checker.scope: algebra and constants only; not universal proof evidence
